new_result_summary: A bordered rank-r skeleton that is near a symmetric matrix can be replaced by a symmetric rank-r carrier at only sqrt(2) times the bordered residual. Combining this with V3=O(rho^-6) and the V1 floor yields at most four physical hubs and complementary diagonal + symmetric rank<=2 + zero-diagonal E with ||E||F <=474.831725961637 eta^-1/2 rho^-3/2; for rho>=12sqrt(pi), <=671.513466699972 rho^-3/2. Low-V2 branch uses only two hubs and rank<=1.
